verdict.rationale: Sumsub's MCP server docs state that agent actions are gated by "your existing Sumsub role permissions," implying some degree of least-privilege control when an AI agent uses the API, and team-member access grants show role-based permissioning exists. However, there is no explicit documentation of issuing a distinct, scoped API key/token specifically for an agent (e.g., token scopes, expiring credentials, or agent-specific API keys) beyond reusing account role permissions. missing for 10: dedicated scoped API-key/token creation for agents, granular permission scoping documentation, independent verification of least-privilege enforcement.
